svg.metadata: {"id": "s016", "name": "羽毛球馆", "cat": "体育", "tags": ["体育", "羽毛球", "协调性", "运动会"], "desc": "室内羽毛球馆端线视角：绿色场地胶上双打/单打边线、前发球线、双打后发球线按标准，球网中高 1.524 m，裁判椅与球拍。", "stand": {"ground_y": 900, "x": [520, 1400]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "wall", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "roof_windows", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "lamps", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.2, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "court", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "net", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "umpire_chair", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.7, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "shuttle_air", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.9, "loop": "bob", "depth": null}, {"name": "props", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.85, "loop": null, "depth": null}], "palette": {"wall1": "#F6F1E7", "wall2": "#E9E0CF", "panel": "#7FB7A4", "panel2": "#5E9E89", "truss": "#C8C0B0", "win1": "#A8DDF7", "win2": "#EAF8FF", "frame": "#FFFFFF", "wood1": "#E2B482", "wood2": "#CF9C66", "mat": "#2F8F6A", "mat2": "#287D5C", "line": "#FFFFFF", "post": "#2E3440", "net": "#2E3440", "tape": "#FFFFFF", "chair": "#F2B33D", "chair2": "#3B4656", "cork": "#F4E7D3", "feather": "#FFFFFF", "band": "#E8574A", "racket": "#3E8ED0", "string": "#E8EEF4", "lamp": "#FFF4CF", "metal": "#9AA8B3", "bag": "#E8574A", "bottle": "#7FC4E8"}}
